_comment: Target longest-bounding-box-axis size (meters) per entity kind, used ONLY to bounds-fit Sketchfab-sourced models at runtime (BoundsFit.cs.j2) — Kenney/default-pack models keep their pack-native scale untouched (normalizing individual modular pieces, e.g. car-kit track segments, would break their relative tiling). A kind with no entry, or value null, gets no fit (fit_size stays 0.0). unity_entity_asset_resolver._register consults this only when pick['source'] == 'sketchfab'.
